Fix missing or mismatched integrity hashes for object files.

This command scans YAML files and registers/updates their integrity hashes in
the hash registry. It's useful for fixing files created outside the CLI or
resolving hash mismatches.

  Fix hashes for a single file
  zqk.test utility fix-hashes docs/process/backlog/BLI-001.yaml
  Fix hashes for all YAML files in a directory (recursive)
  zqk.test utility fix-hashes --recursive docs/process/backlog/
  Fix hashes for all objects of a specific kind
  zqk.test utility fix-hashes --kind audit_event
  Fix hashes for all internal objects
  zqk.test utility fix-hashes --internal
  Force fix hash mismatches (creates audit events)
  zqk.test utility fix-hashes --force docs/process/backlog/BLI-001.yaml
  Dry run (preview changes without writing)
  zqk.test utility fix-hashes --dry-run --kind backlog_item
  Quiet mode (only show errors)
  zqk.test utility fix-hashes --quiet --recursive docs/process/

Usage:
  zqk.test utility fix-hashes [path...] [flags]

Flags:
      --dry-run       Show what would be fixed without making changes
  -F, --force         Force fix hash mismatches (creates audit events)
      --internal      Fix hashes for all internal objects (audit_event, change_journal_entry)
      --kind string   Fix hashes for all objects of the specified kind
  -q, --quiet         Only show errors, suppress success messages
  -r, --recursive     Recursively fix hashes for YAML files in directories
